_game: ARC-AGI-3 tu93: a turn-based maze puzzle in several levels (arcprize.org)
_note: uv sync --extra arc3 (arc3-gym, gym/arc3/, Python >= 3.12), then once with the network on: uv run python -m arc3_gym tu93 (puts the game's files in external/arc3; playing needs no network).
_keys_note: tu93 offers ACTION1-4, so the indices are 0=ACTION1 (up), 1=ACTION2 (down), 2=ACTION3 (left), 3=ACTION4 (right). Other games index their own simple actions in ascending order (see fmri_gym/adapters/arc3.py). Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_menu_note: A level can be a dead end (the game can end before it is solved), so after 15 s of play holding X for 5 s pauses the game and offers Restart / Give up / Resume (UP/DOWN to choose, SPACE to select). See fmri_gym/menu.py.
_curriculum_note: Blocking: the block is the whole game played until won (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1, advancing_outcomes ['won']); a GAME_OVER restarts it from level 1.
